# Purpose
This file is a small C test program for the `fd_txn_account` API. It creates a workspace, allocates memory for a transaction account, and checks that `fd_txn_account_new`, `fd_txn_account_join`, `fd_txn_account_leave`, and `fd_txn_account_delete` handle valid and invalid inputs as expected. The code also verifies account accessors and mutators, including `fd_txn_account_get_data_len`, `fd_txn_account_get_lamports`, `fd_txn_account_get_rent_epoch`, `fd_txn_account_set_lamports`, and `fd_txn_account_set_data_len`, for both read-only and mutable accounts. The program ends by logging `pass` after all tests succeed.
